frontend/src/components/reader/ReaderCon.purpose: Three-state display escalation for the reader: embedded card -> expanded full-browser overlay -> OS fullscreen (synced_reader Task 8)

exports.name: ReaderContainer
exports.contract: displayState driven by useFullscreen.isFullscreen (not tracked independently) + its own embedded<->expanded step. Embedded card stays mounted across every transition (overlay is position:fixed above it) so useFocusTrap's stored previously-focused element can still be refocused on close. role=dialog/aria-modal + useFocusTrap handle focus-in/restore. Escape closes expanded->embedded; native fullscreen exit converges to 'expanded' not 'embedded'. Optional startExpanded prop (Task 9, default false) mounts directly into 'expanded' for the standalone ReaderPage route.
